title: Hinss et al. 2021 — Open multi-session and multi-task EEG cognitive Dataset for passive brain-computer Interface Applications
description: This open-access EEG dataset comprises multi-session, multi-task recordings from 15 healthy participants performing resting state and graded cognitive tasks (easy, medium, difficult) using the MATB-II paradigm. Acquired with 62-channel EEG at 500 Hz sampling rate, the dataset is designed for passive brain-computer interface applications and neuroergonomic research, particularly mental workload estimation. The dataset includes 90 trials per participant across two sessions. Data are provided in raw, unpreprocessed format.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 62-channel ActiCHamp system (Brain Products GmbH) at 500 Hz sampling rate with active Ag/AgCl sensors referenced to Fpz. Standard 10-20 electrode montage was employed with impedance maintained below 25 kOhm. Participants completed two sessions involving resting state and three difficulty levels of the MATB-II task (easy, medium, difficult). Trial intervals were 2 seconds, and data were recorded in EEGLAB .set format.
